Zverev Advances to US Open Quarter-finals

Alexander Zverev has reached the quarter-finals of the U.S. Open after defeating Italian Luciano Darderi in a straight-sets match. The top-seeded German won with a score of 6-2, 6-2, 7-6(3) on Monday. This victory marks a significant step in Zverev's campaign, especially after enduring two previous five-set matches in the tournament.
